Read-only environment inventory for C-final of run 2026-11-09-ui-v3. NO installs, NO downloads, NO edits, and NEVER print secret contents (names/existence only).

Windows host (C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha): report presence + version + path of: cargo-cyclonedx (pinned requirement 0.5.9), docker CLI and daemon state, apksigner and aapt2 (Android build-tools), tauri CLI, NSIS makensis, WiX candle/light (MSI), gitleaks, mdbook, actionlint; plus node/pnpm/cargo versions. List dist/release/v0.2.0/ top level and its upload/ entry NAMES as the local draft bundle template. Inspect apps/mobile/android signing configuration: which keystore/properties paths it references (NAMES ONLY) and whether those files exist (existence only, never contents). Count Cargo.lock workspace-member version lines relevant to scripts/check-versions.mjs --set. List .github/workflows/release.yml job names that request write permissions.

Capture host (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -d Ubuntu -u root -- bash -lc with PATH=/root/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin exported first): presence of actionlint, mdbook, docker; do not run Playwright or touch ports 5173/5174 (a verifier owns them right now).

Deliverable UNDER 350 words: table tool -> present/version/path or MISSING; the v0.2.0 bundle template layout; signing-material existence verdict (exists vs missing = owner-only blocker candidate for the signed APK); mismatches vs pinned requirements (cargo-cyclonedx 0.5.9). State explicitly anything you could not check and why.
